test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct about litmus solution?

options.text: Litmus solution is a purple dye, which is extracted from moss.
Litmus solution is an orange dye, which is extracted from lichen.
Litmus solution is a purple dye, which is extracted from lichen.
Litmus solution is an orange dye, which is extracted from moss.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Litmus solution is a purple dye, which is extracted from lichen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Litmus solution is a common pH indicator used in laboratories.
 
• When the pH is neutral, litmus solution turns Purple.
 
• Litmus paper can be either red or blue; red litmus paper turns blue in basic conditions, and blue litmus paper turns red in acidic conditions.
 
• Neutral pH is considered to be 7, which is the pH of pure water.
 
• Litmus solution is derived from lichens, primarily Roccella tinctoria.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Litmus solution is often used in educational settings to teach students about acids and bases.
 
• Other pH indicators include phenolphthalein, bromothymol blue, and methyl orange, each changing color at different pH levels.
 
• Understanding pH is crucial in various fields, including chemistry, biology, environmental science, and medicine.
